title_as_printed: Experimental values of water mole fraction x(H2O), temperature T, pressure P, and molar volume Vm on the liquid-gas phase equilibrium surface of the binary water-oxygen system. Data up to x(H2O) = 0.900 and more obtained with the "synthetic" method. Data for x(H2O) = 0.930 and more obtained with the analytic method
pressure_note: total pressure at the liquid-gas phase boundary

value.what: water mole fraction: overall filling composition (synthetic rows) or measured liquid-phase composition (analytic rows)

value2.what: molar volume at the phase boundary (synthetic rows only; - for analytic rows)

P_uncertainty.what: pressure uncertainty of analytic rows; printed as '+- 1' after the pressure, split into its own column by the extractor

notes: No label rows. CSV rows 0-72 (73 rows, x(H2O) 0.058-0.899) synthetic-method break points (bubble or dew point, phase not specified, overall composition corrected for dead volume); rows 73-116 (44 rows, x(H2O) 0.93-0.99) analytic liquid-phase samples, x(O2 in liquid) = 1 - x(H2O). Note the text says synthetic data up to 0.900 but the last synthetic rows print 0.899. Printed 'P +- 1' split into P and an uncertainty column; synthetic rows have empty uncertainty cell.
